subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Looking after facilities in my community; keeping places clean and why we should not litter

show.line: Litter makes our community dirty. Put rubbish in the bin!

rounds.prompt: You finish your chips. Where does the packet go?
Looking after the community, or not?

rounds.story: Litter blows into the river. A fish gets a plastic bag stuck on it. Is litter harmful?

rounds.prompt: Say it: I am proud of my community!
accept: i am proud of my community

hints: Litter can hurt animals and people.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I finished my juice.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I throw the box in the street!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Rubbish goes in the bin.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Rubbish in the bin. Clean community!

parent_line: Knows how to look after community places and why not to litter.
